# Four-horde preview after Goldy retires

The rank1 reward branch of random campaign 25 exposes an EndTurn boundary
after 19 inputs. In the original native process, a three-horde Funguy is born
and receives three champion health upgrades (12 to 21). Later, a preview-born
four-horde Funguy receives four upgrades (16 to 28) after the Goldy Whelp and
other cached targets have retired. The guard formerly rejected the preview.

`player-four-horde-goldy-preview-{calibration,replay-calibration}.mt2f` capture
independent native processes before and after the narrowly scoped guard change.
The focused checker matches all 20 inputs, complete successors and RNG, checks
the two observed writes and cache identities, exercises four parallel branches,
and perturbs seven source identities. Existing four-horde retired-companion and
combat-birth native pairs also pass. The retired cached identities are not
evidence of any unobserved internal action. This is not a final-battle win.
